purpose: Produce a machine-checkable next-trigger design after v2 proved that merely mentioning D-1 and D does not guarantee a discrete transition.
objective: Using only supplied repository evidence and finalized adjusted daily OHLCV, propose exactly three semantically distinct trigger families. Each trigger must define one shared scalar state computed for every day and a literal false-to-true or true-to-false threshold crossing from D-1 to D. Do not reuse closed MA-cross, close-to-MA reclaim, or close-above-prior/rolling-high semantics, including algebraic restatements. Select exactly one rank-1 candidate. Do not write code, run experiments, choose acceptance thresholds, infer market participants, or claim profitability.
successCriteria: exactly three machine-parseable CANDIDATE proposal findings
unique featureIds and unique mechanism families
each candidate defines one scalar state independent of D versus D-1 labeling
each candidate uses exactly one of two transition forms: D-1 state <= threshold then D state > threshold, or D-1 state >= threshold then D state < threshold
state formula does not encode price MA crossing/reclaim or close-above-prior/rolling-high breakout
each candidate states fields, bounded parameter family, warmup, chart semantics, event-density risk, and semantic distinctness
exactly one RANK1 candidate and one matching DISCOVERY_CONTRACT next action
rank-1 reason is limited to falsifiability, implementation simplicity, chart traceability, and available data; no participant/catalyst inference
Discovery ranking and acceptance gates remain coordinator-owned
constraints: No new data source, API, server, intraday feed, news, fundamentals, order book, broker state, or participant inference
No close-versus-prior-or-rolling-high trigger, including algebraic state forms such as close-minus-rolling-high
Do not append context filters to a closed trigger
Do not invent profitability or acceptance thresholds
Completed D and earlier information only at t0; executable entry remains D+1 open
Do not write implementation code or run Discovery/Validation
